Better than One Piece

So I want to preface by saying, this game is NOT bad at all. It's really unique, great art, voice acting is pretty good. Concept is cool. However, the ship combat (which is what I was most looking forward to) is the least pertinent part of the game. The ship-to-ship combat consists of TCG-esque (click to attack) targeting combat, the ship movement is a simple click on the next encounter to select it, and automatically "sail" to it. The majority of the important combat is the deck or land fighting, which sadly to say, is not what I was hoping for. As a turn based combat roguelike, I would recommend this game. However, there is no sailing or true ship combat in here at all. Therefore, I will be refunding the title.

Im all for a challenge but this is simply a game of chance, designed to lose. I dont find that kind of game play entertaining. At least Hades made losing entertaining. This game you'll randomly fight a ship with 4 glass cannons, killing most of your mods in the first salvo. Or all the enemies just charge your main guy and pile up to kill him.. All and all I want to like it, but it needs so much work.
Make sure you say good bye to your friends and family before becoming addicted to this, I didn't. I hope they find this review one day and find closure.

游戏是还不错啦，就是平衡差了点，有投矛天赋的女矛手输出跟其它职业完全不是一个等级的，绝对的电动轮椅，重投矛和毒投矛都好使，酒馆看见就招，2个矛手就可以在海上横着走了，准备好五六个投矛可以一路碾压到通关。升级先升晶体炮、专家宿舍、女矛手伤害旗、海战行动点和朗姆酒，其它的都不太着急。这游戏输出大过天，多带晶体炮很容易就能把对面拆成舢板。BOSS可以在攻城阶段用炮轰死，战斗压力会骤减 吐槽：炮台定位的火枪花两个回合打出的一枪不论是伤害还是功能都被女矛手的投矛完全碾压，火枪手完全是小丑。至于其他职业，当你带满女矛手一回合就能把对面全捅成筛子的时候，其它职业真的就只是添头。

If you see this as a "single run rogue-lite" then there is definitively fun to be had here. And I think it is worth ~20€. However, if you are looking for a true rogue-lite experience you can play over and over again with each run feeling different than the last then ... well you probably should stick to something else. There is simply not enough variety here to give you a truly different experience for even your second run.

The main gameplay loop is a lot of fun, and the fights themselves are top notch grid strategy. Would definitely recommend, but it needs to be noted that the voiced dialogue, particularly the main character, and Shiv, are ATROCIOUS. Some of the worst voice acting I've ever heard, by a large margin. If you get it, do yourself a favor and turn speech volume to 0 immediately, as the writing is serviceable. Other than that glaring issue, the story is very weak, and when you get over the intrinsic fun of the system mechanics, there's not much to keep you playing. You go on raids, you upgrade your ship and crew, rinse and repeat. There's nothing to keep you playing unless you find the combat to be worth your time.

总体评价：刚开始很新颖有趣，但只要解锁了全部内容，就开始感觉无聊，热度大概只有4个小时左右，剩下全是刷刷刷的垃圾时间。 人物方面：只有主角、刺客、摔跤手、厨师、女矛手、火枪手、斩击者7个， 主角船长：叠高伤，远程秒一个，近战秒一个，其他人部署在船长周围清其他的怪就行； 刺客：主要配合摔跤手绕敌人后方背刺，以及拿到逃脱+敏捷天赋的话，在商店抢夺时可以一回合走到出口； 摔跤手：自带肉度，我用的是食人族+割喉，割喉自带+1伤害，配合刺客可以一回合打出高伤； 女矛手：真正的火枪手，近可串串AOE，远可投矛单点； 厨师、火枪手、斩击者板凳鸡肋，食之无味。 至于出血、毒药之类的dot，目前我打到终极1，还没体现出用处来，直接一两个回合清掉了，实在不知道dot有什么用。 战斗方面：开战前两船对轰比较关键，前期以拿炮为主，清掉关键组件，防守好对方炮弹，剩下就是清人，可以大幅降低战斗难度。组件起到锦上添花的作用，没有影响也不大。个人装备更是鸡肋，伤害类给主角和矛手，防御类给摔跤手，机动类给刺客。 我前期刷了还是算多的，全部主线通关也只用了12个小时。剩下的更是无聊的解锁成就的垃圾刷子时间，局外养成资源溢出，人物经验严重不够，已经不想继续玩了。 108的游戏只有12个小时的游戏寿命，委实不值。就目前的内容来说，个人感觉最多只值38-48。

TL:DR: Too much emphasis on meta-progress to actually be a tactics game. Less of a "game" than it is an "activity". There's a fundamental problem with the "tactical roguelite" genera which can be more or less severe in different cases, but this game perfectly exemplifies it. The issue stems from the difference in how "difficulty" works in a "tactics" game vs a "roguelite" game. The purest form of roguelite is difficulty-less. Depending on how much meta-progress you've made, an encounter can be simple or trivially un-winnable. You can shift the un-winnable run-ending encounter farther and farther back in the run by making more meta-progress, which requires no skill but only requires you to die over and over again, until finally RNG plus your meta-progress puts you past the finish line. Meanwhile tactics, in its purest form, means puzzles. You have a small number of pieces, with a small number of actions they can take, and a small number of places they can move, which all multiply together to make a moderate number of decisions you can make. When a puzzle is good, of all possible moves, only a clever few will yield the solution. The number proportion of "good" moves should not be so high that you can win just by fumbling around, nor (critically!) should it be zero. Solving a tactics problem is searching with your mind down a bifurcating tree of decisions until, like electricity finding ground, you say "I see it", and you execute. Superficially, Rogue Waters looks like a series of punchy, tight, tactics puzzles. However, because of the extremely heavy influence of roguelite meta-progression - heavy even for a typical roguelite - a given "tactical" encounter's decision tree can terminate in a widely variable proportion of "success" nodes. The proportion can be 0% where an encounter is trivially impossible. The proportion can get so large that you can only lose if you make blunder after blunder (and even then, just die a few more times and you'll win). Once you realize that solving the "tactics puzzle" in front of you is not the slow, cerebral thing it pretends to be and it's really just an idle game + slot machine, you might remember there are lots of roguelites that are flashier, higher-octane, unpretentious, like Hades or Risk of Rain, and you might realize there are lots of tactics games with tighter, more gratifying puzzles, like Triangle Strategy or Into the Breach. Good tactics games pose a moderate number of choices with a carefully designed, narrow band of success. Heavily roguelite games have a band of success that varies widely with RNG + meta-progress from 0% - 100%. There are great examples of both generas, but few good games that are both at once, because this is a fundamental incompatibility. Two of my favorite games are Into the Breach and Slay the Spire, which undeniably have tactical and roguelite elements. But notice the critical difference: The things you unlock by playing Into the Breach and Slay the Spire don't tend to widen or shrink the tactical success band - they only tend to increase the complexity of the game, i.e. the size of the decision tree, while the proportion of paths to success stays relatively constant. You can absolutely win a run in these games without grinding unlocks, and you can easily lose runs despite hundreds or thousands of hours of playtime - while at the same time, runs are almost never unwinnable. Look at the best and worst win rates among Slay the Spire players - the difference is skill, game knowledge, tactical reasoning. In short, the "tactical" aspect of this game is an illusion quickly dispelled, and what's left is an insubstantial grind-fest.

THIS GAME IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK IT IS! Initially this looked really cool. Finally a party based, turn based pirate game. Woohooo. And it is mostly but it's also one of the hardest games around with complicated mechanics and extremely low reward to effort ratio. I played 7 "Raids" and was unable to complete any of them except the first baby raid training mission. By the time you get to the end fight, your crew will be decimated and half dead, your ship will be battered and broken and if you didnt use it on the way to the end fight your one use epic attack will do very little on the last fight. Even if you do complete a Raid your crew will be stuck in recovery for the next 2 or 3 Raids and you'll have to use your backup crew. You CAN heal during combat but only a couple of charaters can do that and you will absolutely NEVER have the time or opportunity to heal everybody by the end of the fight so they start the next one half dead. You CANNOT heal between events and each Raid is 5-10 events (not all of them are combat) Levelling your crew up takes forever.Initially completing 2 raids will get them a level, but from there it takes longer and longer. It seems to me you'd have to "grind" about 30 raids before you had enough crew and enough resources and enough special items to properly build a good crew and a good ship to actually complete a raid completely and be in a good enough position to do another one right away and not start out at zero again. learning all of the mechanics and abilities of the enemy will take quite a while and is very hard to remember as you go along so it's easy to forget something simple and position a crew member slightly wrong, which results in them being dead or seriously injured for the next fight. You will often be outnumbered and outpowered and out-geared. Overall the premise of the game was fine, but the execution was utter ♥♥♥♥♥. If you had the ability to rebuild and heal between events during missions it would be tolerable but still unbelievably grindy but with no out of combat healing and very, very few chances to rebuild your ship during a mission the game is just too hard to be enjoyable and will require at least 30 hours of grinding before you have a good enough crew and ship. But by then, who knows the higher level Raids might just wipe you out too. Could have been great but absolutely isnt. Never EVER pay full price for this. I got it for $21.95 and regret every cent of that.

☠️ Yarrr, by the blackened sails and the Devil’s own luck! This be a game of fair winds and fine sights, where the seas and shores shine like sun on fresh-minted gold. The game loop be smooth as a well-oiled capstan, each task rollin’ into the next till ye swear, “Just one more mission, then I’ll berth.” Every voyage brings new secrets to unearth. Lost ruins, hidden bounties, and wonders what set a fire in a sailor’s heart. And mark me words: the tale itself ain’t just bilge and bluster, but a yarn worth hearin’, with twists enough to keep even a weathered old salt leanin’ in closer. Once ye set foot upon this deck, lad, the siren’s call won’t let ye go — not till the candles burn low and the horizon fades to dawn. 🏴‍☠️

游戏特色是海盗氛围的营造，海盗脑的玩家可以无脑入。游戏将肉鸽的随机元素与战棋策略巧妙结合，每一次出海都是全新的航程，随机生成的遭遇战、事件与宝藏，让玩家能始终保持探索欲。战斗系统的设计呢比较有新意，比如海战阶段的大炮对轰需要精准瞄准敌方船舰关键部位，登船后的回合制近战则可利用绳索摆荡爆菊、地形杀等机制--如把敌人推向墙壁或捡起炸弹反扔。再搭配船员的独特技能，每一场战斗都充满策略性。此外，还可招募船员、使用海怪助战、升级船舰等养成元素，也让玩家能打造专属海盗团，沉浸感十足。音画配合舒适，简洁易用也做的可以，游玩顺畅，单买10.8内入库没毛病。 特有规则或键位备忘：退出游戏自动存档。 画面：**** 音乐：**** 剧情：*** 演出：**** 玩法：*** 创意：**** 手感：**** 难度：**** 丰富：**** 耐玩：**** 优化：**** 更新：** 热情：** 细节：*** 打磨：*** 诚意：**** 不足，bug，建议等：翻译比机翻强能看，如果可以请再次校对纠正。 202512，steam，steam掉卡掉物抵扣，它处自定义包入的Rogue Waters (China Region Locked) (China) key本体约9元。爱人如己，目前就这，看以后追评。

Humble包里也是难得有个合我胃口的。 肉鸽+战棋+海战。 整体流程上有点像前些年流行的基于XCOM模式的战棋肉鸽，但单局更加肉鸽化、流程更长，并且没有死亡损失（哪怕局内死透了，回家睡几天也就痊愈了）。这方面给我的体验还是不错的，毕竟实在厌恶失去。不过装备、道具之类的东西也是肉鸽化了，只在单局内有效，养出一个神将以后戛然而止、多少会有些不尽兴。 战斗部分，机制和数值比较精致（例如大部分角色初始攻击力都是1，生命值个位数）。AI智能不赖，经常会给我带来意想不到的减员。前期就能感受到有一定的挑战性，稍微打点高难战斗的话，还是得坐起来认真玩的。场景互动元素丰富，用好了可以起死回生、额外击杀、甚至扭转战局，这一块比许多肉鸽战棋都做得好。 海战跟登船结合的挺好的，不是千篇一律的数值对轰、无脑升船，而是从构筑时就要精心搭配、并且在海战的每个回合都要思考策略。守坏了，自己就少人少buff；攻好了，对面就少人少buff。海战的细节可以说是对接下来的登船有极大影响。大概是我见过的海战玩法里处理得最好的之一。 养成流程中规中矩吧，就是一些常见的全局强化。局内表现越好，带出来的养成资源越多。不过有一个比较亮眼的点——每个角色都是1个固定天赋树+2个随机天赋树，可能能提供不错的构筑深度。另外，当你局外养成练起来以后，就得自己去找合适的局内难度了，找不好的话，就会失去战棋那种精致的紧张平衡感。 在大约玩了两三个小时之后，XCOM模式的问题也开始显现了——要管理的内容量线性增长，越玩到后面越麻烦。就个人来说，不太能接受这种管理大量角色和道具的战棋，还是更喜欢那些培养一支精英小队的战棋。

A decent game that's absolutely not worth 38.99$ CAD. Has some glaring bugs that don't really detract from the experience, some unfinished mechanics and could use a decent amount of polish... but what's there is a creative, interesting roguelite that has unique mechanics. The pre-battle ship combat is a crazy cool mechanic with loads of player agency, the actual combat itself has a pretty big skill ceiling, there's a lot of smart design at play here. It's a roguelite with a clear narrative progression and metaprogression that's very, very important and powerful. If you can get this game at a reasonable price (which should be possible, it's on the Humble Choice of May 2026 so keysites probably have a bunch of low price keys), then it's definitely worth your time. But at full price, there's just a lot of better video games to play out there first that'll be cheaper and better in the whole.

Rogue Waters is a decent turn based roguelike. It gets points for being different. You're a pirate, you choose a path on a map, you have shipfight then board the ship or fort and have a srpg battle. Story is servicable. Battles are fun and have some depth. ～一款回合制战棋肉鸽游戏。你扮演一位被利用、进而被诅咒成为不死之身的海盗。为了复仇，你需要组建自己的队伍，通过一次次的航行、死亡与积累，最终报复那个利用你的老船长。 ～每场战斗在真正跳到敌舰之前，双方会先进行三轮炮击对射。每一轮，你都可以做出战术选择：炮击敌方的船员，削弱对方跳帮战时的战力；打掉敌船的设施，以减少敌方人员增益；把炮弹用在压制对方火炮上，以减少自己船只受到的伤害。不同的选择会直接影响后续跳帮战的难度和局面。 ～登上敌船后，进入策略战棋玩法。其中有一个关键的攻守进退机制：多数攻击动作会让攻击方与防守方同时产生位移——被攻击者会向后退出一步，而攻击方则会向前跟进，占据其原来的位置。如果被击退的方向有其他单位（无论是友方还是敌方），则会引发撞击伤害，撞到的人也会受伤。如果被攻击者后方没有可以退让的格子，则该次攻击会直接造成额外伤害。这一机制让每一场跳帮战都需要考量站位与走位，留意阵型，利用撞击去连锁杀伤敌人，同时避免自己的船员被逼入死角。 ～每次出航的流程不长，类似《杀戮尖塔》那样选择路线树。无论本次航行成功完成任务还是最终失败，你在途中获得的所有物品、船件，在结算时都会折算为两种资源：蓝图与晶体。蓝图：用于升级船只的各类设施（火炮、船件）。晶体：用于强化海怪能力，以及招募和培养船员，让下一次出航的初始阵容更强大。
浅体验： 评分6/10 玩法融合或者说机制创新都非常不融洽，整体的战棋玩法体验完全是灾难。局内各种随机性强度完全可有可无甚至可以说莫名其妙，战斗简陋空洞，难度曲线完全崩坏，几乎没有正反馈，几乎所有的强度都来自于局外升级，完全违背正常战棋成长发展的游戏逻辑，可惜了还不错的画面和美术风格。

An excellent little game I recommend to any turn based game devotees. While not a simulation of pirate war it has the spirit of the age and the upgrade system is a fine one that lets you build a true pirate crew.

[h3]It's no X-COM or CRPG masterpiece, but it does provide a serviceable tactical turn-based approach with a rogue-lite design that can comfortably deliver a pirate themed journey on the high seas.[/h3] I really did like how much positioning and contact based physics played a role in the combat on the ship as well as how you have to make tactical and strategic decisions about which parts of the enemy ship to shoot during sea battles. Having each "module" on a ship responsible for a corresponding buff or capability for a unit in the boarding combat was a nice touch. Though it's to be expected from the rogue-lite design, it can feel a little grindy trying to take you weak ship and crew and do enough runs to buy better everything so you can go farther the next time. The nature of RNG for some of the encounters can also hand you a swift and bitter defeat when you least expect it. The upside obviously being the immense feeling of satisfaction when you finally do put those feared enemies in the ground for the first time. Thanks to Humble Choice Monthly for putting this one in front of me. [b]P.S.[/b] - Maybe I just didn't play long enough, but I didn't encounter a lot of the UI issues people mentioned in their reviews.

TL;DR: Excellent game, but severely buggy and in the hands of developers so incompetent and careless that their every attempt to patch it just creates new issues. There's a lot to love about this game. Like, it's genuinely a lot of fun! As a Roguelite, it's more 'lite' than 'Rogue' - sure, your ship resets after every expedition, but your crew accrues XP and you get currency you can use for permanent upgrades, and this happens regardless of whether your expedition ended in death or victory, so it's very forgiving. The gameplay is overall solid, and the only criticism I could really make is that the ship-to-ship battle-system is overly random, with cannons dealing, for example, 1-3 damage, or 0-5 damage, which can create a situation where your expedition founders purely because a series of bad rolls led to your ship getting blasted to splinters. It seems particularly dumb when considering how brilliant the 'boarding' combat is - being completely deterministic, with no 'chance to miss' or range of damage. As long as you think through every turn, you know exactly what you're going to get from each move, and you can even take moves back if you realize you miscalculated. That's the way to do things in a Roguelike, IMO, since randomness is going to be a huge factor regardless - in terms of what gear, powerups and cannons you get your hands on, and what enemies you wind up fighting - that you really don't need to add even more randomness to the actual battles... But, that alone wouldn't have earned a thumbs-down, not even close. I mean, hey, no game is perfect, and everything ELSE is excellent. No, the real problem is much simpler - it's BUGGY. Perpetually, severely buggy, despite being TWO YEARS OLD. Now, I've personally never felt the need to make allowances for bugs in newly-released games - if you're charging me money for it, can calling it a finished product rather than an early-access title, it better be because its ACTUALLY FINISHED - but it's still undeniably common for new releases to have a few bugs, that can be expected to be fixed over the next few months. This, again, has been out for TWO YEARS, and they're still patching serious issues, with such blithe incompetence that they create new, equally-serious bugs each time. Currently, enemies you have stunned cannot be targeted with attacks (the same NOT being true for YOUR characters when stunned), and armored enemies cannot be targeted with armor-breaking or armor-penetrating special moves. I'm sure you'll recognize that as 'fairly serious bugs'. Maybe they'll have patched those by the time you read this, but going by performance so far, that'll just mean that a bunch of NEW fun bugs have been added instead! Just as a footnote, though, there's some indication that the game is no longer in the hands of the people who originally developed it - it's been handed over to some other bunch who are making DLC for it - which, if true, could explain A LOT... but it doesn't really change the final, badly-flawed result.

——记录：《Rogue Waters / 恶棍水域》，May 2026 Humble Choice月包，2026/05/06入。 ——海盗题材回合制战术肉鸽，主打「远程海战炮击 + 甲板接舷战」双阶段战斗，搭配船员养成、永久升级与三幕复仇剧情。核心战斗机制有新意、战术深度充足，海盗氛围纯正，是近年肉鸽品类里完成度不错的题材向作品。 ——综合评分：7.4/10 ——背景&剧情 玩家扮演海盗船长卡特，曾是传奇海盗黑骨船长的得力副手。在一场背叛中，卡特被黑骨夺走一切、沉入深海，却因海洋守护者的古老预言获得了不死之身。 重生之后，卡特集结杂牌船员、驾着破船重返诅咒海域，在程序生成的危险航路上一路追查黑骨的踪迹，揭开海牧人预言的真相，最终向不死的宿敌完成复仇。 剧情分为三幕推进，沿途穿插船员个人故事、岛屿奇遇与神话伏笔，整体是标准的海盗复仇爽文路子，没有过于复杂的反转，但叙事完整度在肉鸽游戏里属于中上水平。沿途的选择会影响船员好感、资源获取与分支事件，一定程度上丰富了单局的变数。 ——玩法&特色 1.船员养成与职业系统：开局可从 6 种职业中招募船员，分别对应战士、枪手、医师、炮手、斥候、水手长，各有专属技能树与定位。每局冒险中船员会随机获得不同天赋，局外可在海盗洞穴基地解锁永久升级，强化职业基础属性与通用技能。特别的是，船员伤害会跨局继承，重伤的船员下一局无法直接出战，需要轮换替补休整，强制要求玩家培养多套阵容，不能靠一队莽到底。 2.肉鸽探索&事件抉择：每局航行都是程序生成的海域地图，沿途分布着敌舰、宝藏岛、神秘事件、商人港口与 BOSS 据点。选择不同航线会遇到完全不同的遭遇，可能捡到强力装备、触发船员剧情、召唤神话海怪助阵，也可能遭遇风暴损失物资。 和多数肉鸽一样，死亡即清空本局所有临时资源，但会积累永久升级货币，让下一局开局更强，挫败感控制得比较适中。 3.海怪召唤与舰船升级：冒险途中可解锁克拉肯、塞壬等神话海怪，战斗中可召唤释放大范围必杀，视觉冲击力与战术价值兼备；舰船本身也可在局内局外双重升级，强化护甲、火力、速度与载货量，自由度比较充足。 4.双阶段战斗：最核心的特色设计，每场战斗都分为两个阶段。 第一阶段：海上炮战，双方舰船在海面走位对轰。 第二阶段：接舷网格战，敌舰血量降到阈值后触发接舷，视角切换为等距网格回合制战斗。 海战 + 接舷战的组合跳出了传统回合制战术的框架，远程削弱、近战收割的节奏富有层次。网格战中的推击、地形杀、技能组合有不少操作空间，不同职业搭配能玩出完全不同的打法，策略性在同价位肉鸽里属于第一梯队。 ——题材与玩法结合得比较好的战术肉鸽，双阶段战斗是最大亮点，海盗氛围与剧情完成度也超出预期。推荐喜欢回合制战术游戏、偏爱海盗题材的玩家。26/07/20
